title: Gorham's Cave Complex, Gibraltar
summary: Gorham's Cave Complex is a group of four caves on the eastern side of the Rock of Gibraltar, inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2016. Neanderthals inhabited the caves for more than 100,000 years; the date of the last occupation is debated, and a 2006 excavation report put most dated objects at about 28,000 years old.

uncertainty.note: Start: 'more than 100,000 years' of Neanderthal occupation (EBSCO), so only a minimum span; end: 'about 32,000 years ago' (EBSCO; year approximated as -30050), but a 2006 report gave about 28,000 and the final date is debated.
